explication: go-git is a pure-Go Git implementation library with high-level repository operations and lower-level plumbing. A typical user opens or clones a repository, operates on revisions and objects, and reads results from a selected storage backend; clone and fetch also communicate with a remote. The README documents filesystem and in-memory storage, while sampled sources expose the repository API, client transports, and backend construction. Several feature modules are present in the tree but were not sampled, so their internal call paths are not asserted here.
